retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochrome portrait featuring a subject with voluminous 80s hair, framed by vibrant red geometric sans-serif typography in both horizontal and vertical orientations.
triggerTerms: monochrome photo with red geometric text
excludeWhen: modern minimalist flat design is requested
serif or script typography is specified

recipe.visualDefinition: A black and white close-up portrait of a woman with large, textured hair, leaning against a dark leather surface. The composition is anchored by bold, thin-stroke red sans-serif text that spans the top edge and runs vertically down the right side.
coreVisualRelationships: Red typography creates a vibrant frame against the monochrome subject
The subject's diagonal shoulder line leads the eye to the vertical text
The high-contrast lighting on the face balances the heavy black of the clothing
The circular 'O' in the top left mirrors the soft curves of the hair and leather
coreInvariants: Vertical text orientation on the right margin

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered and occupies the lower two-thirds of the frame, appearing in a medium close-up shot.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large red 'O' in the top left corner serves as the primary entry point for the eye.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the top-left 'O', moves across the horizontal name, drops down the right-side vertical title, and settles on the subject's face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark, textured leather background provides negative space that emphasizes the subject's light hair and the red text.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in the photo; maximum saturation in the red graphic elements.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'O' is oversized and perfectly circular
The 'A' lacks a crossbar in some variations or has a very low one
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different orientations and scales for consistency.
graphicDevices: Circular monogram logo in bottom left

candidateDirections.reason: Classic geometric sans with sharp apexes and circular forms.
Captures the 70s/80s geometric editorial feel perfectly.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white photograph of a woman with voluminous 1980s feathered hair, wearing a black off-the-shoulder top, leaning against a dark textured leather sofa.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay uppercase geometric sans-serif text in bright red. Place the primary name across the top with wide tracking. Place the secondary title vertically down the right side, one letter per line, with wide spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the text a vibrant, pure red?
Is the right-side text stacked vertically?

mustRedesign: Horizontal text on the right side

mustAchieve: Clear separation between red text and B&W background

postGenerationChecks: Check that the red text does not have a drop shadow.
Ensure the vertical text is perfectly aligned to the right margin.
Verify the monochrome photo has deep, true blacks.
Confirm the typography is the only color element in the image.
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome Portrait + Geometric Red Sans-Serif (Horizontal Top + Vertical Right) = 80s Pop Aesthetic
